Name: Farmer's new shoes
Author: OneCubic
Description:
[size=6]Now you can download the [CP] pattern I just released, it doesn't need to be replaced, it's here [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25974/]More lovely farmers image at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]


修改了男农夫和女农夫的鞋子！
请注意：这是XNB文件，需要替换游戏文件。
替换路径：Stardewvalley→Content→Characters→Farmer

Changed the shoes for male and female farmers!
[/size][color=#ff0000][size=5]Please note: This is a Grams file and needs to be replaced.
Altnatpasta: Stardewvalley→Content→Characters→Farmer

[/size][/color][size=4]做这个mod是因为没有人做这个mod，我玩游戏的时候老是被农夫的大鞋子吸引，那实在太奇怪了。。。于是我一顿修改，终于完工！
现在分享出来供大家下载！
This mod is made because no one makes this mod, I am always attracted to the farmer's big shoes when I play the game, it is so weird... So I made a few revisions, and it was finally finished!
Share it now for everyone to download![/size]
